item.title: Richard Wolfsdorf Aka Ricardo Villalobos - MDMA (reissue)
item.description: Label: Sei Es Drum | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: Minimal , Minimal Techno
item.content:encoded:
Label: Sei Es Drum

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: Minimal , Minimal Techno

In his early years in the 90s, the now iconic minimal man Ricardo Villalobos recorded as Richard Wolfsdorf, and one of the gems from that era is this. It is a heavily sought-after two-tracker that has been remastered for this reissue. 'MDMA' is the real highlight - a brain-frying blend of electric synth work, sine waves, buzzy tones and ever more pressurised drums that add up to peak time and trippy techno excellence. 'Bosch' is then a more stripped-back deep techno mind melter with wonky pads and taught drums all working towards a climax that will still get floors going wild all these years on.

Tracklist:

  • A1.MDMA
  • B1. Bosh

item.title: Lars Bartkuhn - See The Light
item.description: Label: Rush Hour | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: House , Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Rush Hour

Prix: 16,00 €

Style: House , Deep House

Lars Bartkuhn returns to Dutch legends Rush Hour with a thrilling three-mix release showcasing his deep, intricate sound. Originally conceived as his final exploration into house music, the track pushes dancefloor boundaries with fresh structural ideas and interesting compositional twists. The Full Experience Mix is a near 13-minute odyssey of raw piano solos, deep chords, lush vocals and intricate percussion that all reveal Bartkuhn's emotional vulnerability and ability to express that in music. The Inner Experience dub hones in on mesmerising keys and synths while the Dub Reprise emphasises rhythmic drive with its chugging beats. This is house music reimagined.

Tracklist:

  • A1. See The Light (Full Experience)
  • B1. See The Light (Inner Experience)
  • B2. See The Light (dub reprise)

item.title: Terry Francis - El Tel Collection
item.description: Label: Pariter | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: Tech House , Dub House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Pariter

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: Tech House , Dub House

The agenda-setting Sushitech has a just as influential sub-label, Pariter, which welcomes the one and only tech house instigator, Terry Francis, for a rare and essential reissue. Francis was there at the birth of original tech house with his killer Wiggle parties and fabric residency and now kicks off what will be a limited series that digs into his archives. These first offerings were originally released on Eukahouse 25 years ago, with opener 'Notice Board' bringing a thumping low end and wiggling bassline that is topped with smooth chord work. 'Hello, Acid Dathera' (unreleased retake version) is a busier sound with a tribal edge and restless drums and bass with acid daubs and crisp hi-hats, making it a full body workout.

  • B1.

item.title: Dexter - Paradox (Reissue)
item.description: Label: Repeat | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: House , Tech House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Repeat

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: House , Tech House

A punctual reissue of a rare Eye 4 Sound tech-acid house party starter from 2004, this Repeat version of Dexter's 'Paradox' stays faithful to one of many EPs in UK artist Mat Royall's regal flush of technical itches to last from 01 to 06, spread across labels like Beat Code, Random House and, in more recent years, Real Deal and Bosh Records. 'Paradox' is subset by the fun-loving 'Ychtm Acid' on the B-side, and while we can't claim to be so clever as to be able to decode this standout track's strange titular acronym, we can vouch for the sickness of its eccentric percussions and atmosphere, a fine case of what we call "mood design".

item.title: Alton Miller - Spirit Chaser
item.description: Label: Quintessentials | Prix: 18,00 € | Style: House , Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Quintessentials

Prix: 18,00 €

Style: House , Deep House

Is there a more under-celebrated producer in deep house than Alton Miller? The Detroiter has been serving up sublime slabs of classy dancefloor deepness for decades (he made is debut way back in 1993) and has recorded for all manner of inspired imprints, but for one reason or another his work has not been celebrated as much as many of his peers. As this Quintessentials outing shows, Miller remains a master of his craft. Side A is all about 'Last One First', a lightly spacey slab of richly electronic Motor City deep house futurism that comes accompanied by the breezier, warmer and lighter 'Life Recorder remix'. In contrast, 'Give It Up' is gentler, sunnier and effortlessly soulful, with Shaka successfully re-framing it as a lightly Latin-tinged slab of soulful house jazziness.

Tracklist:

  • A1.Last One 1st
  • A2. Last One 1st (Life Recorder remix)

item.title: TV.BABIES/Smart Alex - Deeper Situation - Peace Division Rmx
item.description: Label: Endell Street | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: UK Tech House Reissue
item.content:encoded:
Label: Endell Street

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: UK Tech House Reissue

Endell Street returns with another essential deep-dive into London's early 2000s tech house archives. The A-side unearths the long-lost TV Babies project and their 'Deeper Situation', a hidden treasure from some of the scene's most respected selectors, complete with gritty drums and a sense of swagger that is textbook for the era. On the flip, cult duo Peace Division's heavyweight remix of Smart Alex is more leggy and funky, with loopy kicks topped with wet cymbals, an eerie breakdown and a killer drop that is punchy and authentic, so it is likely to be huge all over again two decades on.

Tracklist:

  • A1.TV Babies - Deeper Situation
  • B1. Smart Alex - Specially Hot (Peace Division remix)

item.title: Teflon Dons/Coastal Commission - The Rendezvous ( Reissue)
item.description: Label: Pacific Coast House | Prix: 22,00 € | Style: House , Tech House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Pacific Coast House

Prix: 22,00 €

Style: House , Tech House

Sam Robson continues to reissue gems from the vaults of his initially short-lived Pacific Coast House Recordings imprint, which released a string of superb West Coast house singles between 1999 and 2003. This split 12" originally landed way back in 2001 and has become something of an in-demand rarity in recent years. The now-familiar Teflon Dons handle side A, wrapping jaunty, spaced-out stabs, intergalactic pads, echo-laden vocal snippets and TB-303 style moody electronics around a hybrid acid house/tech-house groove on the swirling and immersive early morning delights of 'Vice'. Over on side B, Robson dons his The Coastal Commission guise for a deeper, dub-flecked and breakbeat-enhanced house workout that adds cosmic spoken word snippets and effects-laden ambient chords to the San Fran deep house template drawn up by Dubtribe Soundsystem and Charles Webster.

Tracklist:

  • A1. The Coastal Commission - Our Music
  • B1. Teflon Dons - Vice

item.title: K Alexi - Warehouse Trax
item.description: Label: Dark Entries | Prix: 25,00 € | Style: Chicago House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Dark Entries

Prix: 25,00 €

Style: Chicago House

Newly recovered from early-90s Chicago tape reels, Warehouse Trax captures Windy City favourite K Alexi in an instinctive mood. The 'Dark Entries' EP gathers six previously unreleased cuts that balance acid menace with soulful undertones but all rooted firmly in the lineage of the legendary Music Box. Salsa-tinged rhythms and warm bass drive 'Jungle Line', while 'Protect and Survive' slows things down with emotional weight and hip-house swing. Elsewhere, 'Aaaah' leans into tougher rave aesthetics, its pounding drums and ominous pads recalling Europe's harder underground, before 'Klub Dred' flips the script with stripped-back half-time dub and clipped vocal echoes. A vital snapshot of Chicago house history that still sounds alive.

Tracklist:

  • A2. Aaaah
  • A3. Do You Feel
  • B1. Black Mystery
  • B2. Klub Dred
  • B3. Protect & Survive

item.title: Forward Memory/Thomas + James / Beppu/Gradient - Various Artists 002
item.description: Label: Alt Dub | Prix: 24,00 € | Style: Dub Techno
item.content:encoded:
Label: Alt Dub

Prix: 24,00 €

Style: Dub Techno

Federsen's Alt/Dub imprint has grown into a small but distinctive corner of the West Coast dub-techno scene and this second Artist Series release shows how widely that influence now stretches. Forward Memory sets the tone with 'Scholz's Star'. It's a drifting pulse shaped by hand-played percussion and soft, hovering synths. Thomas + James bring a deeper physicality on 'Chosen Colour' where rolling low-end pushes through a mist of glowing pads. Gradient shifts the focus on the flip that leans into lighter, glassier stabs on 'Vibes Realm'. Beppu closes with 'Conversions', a restless mesh of hiss, echo and broken rhythms that feels like it's unspooling into open space. A calm, detailed snapshot of dub techno's outer edges.

Tracklist:

  • A1.Forward Memory - Scholz's Star
  • A2. Thomas + James - Chosen Colour
  • B1. Gradient - Vibes Realm
  • B2. Beppu - Conversions
